ministry-of-protocol.reason: 0 calls since April; every ministry formats its own work and Forseti checks it

slots._comment: The Legion bus. `required` names cards that MUST be present and loadable; if one is absent or refused, the whole bus enters restricted mode and runs nothing, and the Emperor is told at priority 1. Required-ness lives here rather than in a card's manifest on purpose: a manifest cannot declare the requirement of a folder that has been deleted, which is the case that matters most.

panel._comment: THESIS_G, signed 2026-11-10. Required: the thesis is forward-only, so a night lost to a silently missing card can never be recovered. Every other value the thesis depends on is fixed by the signed charter and lives in the card's code under the charter hash, NOT here, because the operator may change this file at will and may not change a signed charter.

supervision._comment: Borrowed from Erlang/OTP: bounded retries, then disable and escalate. `after` is rest_for_one.
supervision._comment_timeout: timeout_min is the Warden's bell, set ABOVE each runner's own internal timeout on purpose: a runner that reports its own clean timeout is worth more than one the Warden abandons, so it gets room to fail on its own terms first. There is no way to opt out.
supervision._comment_panel: attempts:1 on purpose — a retry would re-run API calls already paid for and could half-record an observation. One try, then the night abstains and is logged.

intercom._comment: The Intercom (INTERCOM.md + Amendment 1): agent-to-agent mail. Dark until this is true AND Amendment 1 is initialed. Turning it on needs a Warden restart; turning it off again is this one line. While false the night runs exactly as it did before.
